documentation.content: More than 2% of API responses are 5xx (and at least 3 in 5 minutes). Open RUNBOOK.md, section "Sentry alert triage"; check the newest Sentry issue and `make logs ENV=${ENV}`. If it began with a deploy, `make rollback ENV=${ENV}`.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="${SERVICE}" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx"

conditions.displayName: At least 3 5xx in 5 minutes (so one failed request on a quiet night does not page you)

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="${SERVICE}" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx"
